name: Apple Chips
desc: Thin apple slices baked low until crisp, then seasoned with salt, pepper, and chaat masala.

source.title: Baked Apple Chips
source.evidence: Method, apple count, lemon juice, 200°F and about 2 hours from this page. The savory salt, pepper and chaat masala seasoning is the site's own; its amounts are judgment.

ingredients.raw: 4 medium Fuji or Honeycrisp apples (about 1 1/2 lb)

steps: Preheat the oven to 200°F and line 3 to 4 baking sheets with parchment paper.
Core the apples with an apple corer and slice them crosswise about 1/8 inch thick (a mandoline keeps them even). Toss the slices gently with the lemon juice in a large bowl.
Lay the slices on the parchment in a single layer, not touching.
Bake 1 hour, flip each slice, and bake about 1 hour more, until the edges curl and the slices feel dry and leathery. Rotate the pans between racks at the flip.
Stir the salt, pepper, and chaat masala together and sprinkle over the warm chips. Let cool completely on the pans; they crisp as they cool. Store airtight.
tips: Trisha Yearwood's version bakes about 2 hours without flipping and seasons with sugar, cinnamon, and a pinch of salt instead, for a sweet chip.
Thicker or uneven slices stay chewy in the center; if some are still soft after 2 hours, give them 15 more minutes.
